requirement.original: wrap envelope type renders as Unknown event instead of collapsible skill/command prompt. typesRaw.ts correctly normalizes wrap envelopes to wrapped type with label and content, but AgentEventBlock in MessageView.tsx has no case for type wrapped.
requirement.clarified: Add a 'wrapped' case to AgentEventBlock in MessageView.tsx that renders wrap envelopes as collapsible blocks with label header and expandable markdown content body, defaulting to collapsed.
requirement.what: Add missing 'wrapped' event type handling to AgentEventBlock component
requirement.why: Wrap envelopes (skill/command prompts like /commit, /review-pr) render as 'Unknown event' instead of their intended collapsible label+content display

included: Add wrapped case to AgentEventBlock switch logic
Render content as expandable markdown body
Add necessary styles to existing StyleSheet

success_criteria: Wrap envelopes render with their label as a styled header (not 'Unknown event')
Content is collapsed by default and expandable on tap
Existing event types (switch, message, limit-reached) render unchanged
constraints: Must use existing MarkdownView for content rendering
Must follow Unistyles pattern for styles
Must use Pressable for tap handling
No new component files -- inline in MessageView.tsx

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Wrap envelope messages show 'Unknown event' text in the session view
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: AgentEventBlock in MessageView.tsx:108-149 only handles 'switch', 'message', and 'limit-reached' event types. The 'wrapped' type (normalized from 'wrap' envelope in typesRaw.ts:584) has no matching case, so it falls through to the default 'Unknown event' return at line 144.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - the wrapped type was added to typesRaw.ts but AgentEventBlock was never updated to handle it
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The wrap envelope type and its normalization to 'wrapped' AgentEvent were added as part of the session protocol, but the rendering component was not updated to handle the new type
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Users see 'Unknown event' for every skill/command invocation (e.g., /commit, /review-pr) instead of the intended collapsible prompt display
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present since wrap envelope support was added to typesRaw.ts

context.codebase_state: wrap envelope normalization works correctly in typesRaw.ts, only rendering is missing

development_approach.strategy: Add a new if-block for props.event.type === 'wrapped' in AgentEventBlock, before the default fallback. Use React.useState for expand/collapse state. Render label in a Pressable header with chevron icon, and conditionally render MarkdownView for content when expanded.
development_approach.validation_approach: 1. yarn typecheck passes. 2. Visual verification via Playwright on dev.life-ai.app that wrap envelopes show label+collapsible content instead of 'Unknown event'. 3. Verify existing event types still render correctly.
